# Del Piccolo Diavolo — Staffordshire Bull Terrier Kennel

> Ethical Staffordshire Bull Terrier kennel, active since 2013 in Ostellato (Ferrara, Emilia-Romagna, Italy). Responsible selection focused on health, breed type and temperament. Puppies released with ENCI pedigree, genetic testing of the breeding stock (L2HGA and HC), microchip, vaccinations and lifelong support for the family.

Useful information about this site:

- Breeder: Paolo Boldrini
- Location: Ostellato (FE), Emilia-Romagna, Italy
- Breed: Staffordshire Bull Terrier
- Bloodlines: English (Elitebull) and Irish (Lackyle)
- Results: Italian and foreign Champions, 4th place at the World Dog Show
- Puppies are released with ENCI pedigree
- Site languages: Italian (main), English, German
- Contact: WhatsApp +39 392 4635584 · email zonerosse@gmail.com

## Notes

- The kennel produces few litters per year and selects the families carefully.
- Health and temperament come before aesthetics; no pairings with dilute (blue) dogs.
- The main site is in Italian at https://delpiccolodiavolo.it/ ; a German version is available at /de/.
